issue_context.title: [BUG] Delete repo do not delete related issue_label entrys
issue_context.body:
tested with gitea 1.14.0+dev-877-g0e5c6c449

reproduce:
1. create repo with 1 issue and 1 label
1. assign label to issue
1. delete repo
1. exec: `select COUNT(issue_label.id) from issue_label LEFT JOIN issue ON issue_label.issue_id = issue.id LEFT JOIN label ON issue_label.label_id = label.id WHERE issue.id IS NULL OR label.id IS NULL;`
